collection.name: UNITY (SNAPSHOT TAKEN)
collection.description:
**SNAPSHOT TAKEN - CONTAINS 0 $JOY**

UNITY SPARKS $JOY

UNITY represents 10,000 $JOY tokens, which aim to be the largest and most distributed airdrop on the Spark protocol.

The 20,000 UNITY inscriptions make up 20% of the total $JOY supply.  This 20% supply comes from a portion of the top 20,000 wallets receiving $JOY.

Check out the website for allocation & the eligible 42 communities that were part of the snapshot that has already been taken.

Once Spark protocol is integrated to current wallets & platforms (such at XVerse & Magic Eden), we will do the full $JOY airdrop.

All UNITY tokens held at the time will count towards ones allocation. Inscription allocations are stackable (eg. 1 UNITY = 10,000 $JOY, 5 UNITY = 50,000 $JOY, etc).
